questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who wrote the humorous short story 'A Pinch of Snuff'?
questions.explanation: 'A Pinch of Snuff' prasiddh lekhak Manohar Malgaonkar dwara likhi gayi ek rochak kahani hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Manohar Malgaonkar born?
questions.explanation: Manohar Malgaonkar ka janam saal 1913 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year did Manohar Malgaonkar pass away?
questions.explanation: Manohar Malgaonkar ka dehavsan saal 2010 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which type of prose piece is 'A Pinch of Snuff'?
questions.explanation: 'A Pinch of Snuff' sahityik vidha ke roop mein ek laghu kahani (short story) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of these literary compositions is written by Manohar Malgaonkar?
questions.explanation: 'Distant Drum' Manohar Malgaonkar ki prasiddh rachnaon mein se ek hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who came to Delhi to see a minister?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka kisi mantri se milne ke uddeshya se Delhi aaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which season did Nanukaka visit Delhi?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka garmiyon ke mausam (Summer) mein Delhi aaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following books is NOT written by Manohar Malgaonkar?
questions.explanation: 'Two Leaves and a Bud' Mulk Raj Anand ki rachna hai, Malgaonkar ki nahi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'A Pinch of Snuff' is primarily a .......... story.
questions.explanation: Yeh kahani hasya aur chaturai bhare romanch (comic and adventurous) se bharpoor hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The narrator of 'A Pinch of Snuff' was a/an .......... on probation.
questions.explanation: Kathavachak mantralaya mein probation par ek Under-Secretary the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who was very loyal towards her side of the family?
questions.explanation: Lekhak ki maa apne maike aur apne bhai Nanukaka ke prati behad nishthawan theen.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: For how long was Nanukaka supposed to stay in Delhi?
questions.explanation: Maa ne lekhak ko bataya tha ki Nanukaka keval 2 ya 3 din hi rukenge.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who informed the Under-Secretary about Nanukaka's arrival?
questions.explanation: Lekhak ko Nanukaka ke aane ki suchna unki maa ne di thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Nanukaka was the narrator's ..........
questions.explanation: Nanukaka rishte mein lekhak ke mama (maternal uncle) the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who was waiting on the platform when the train arrived?
questions.explanation: Train aane par station ke platform par lekhak unka intezar kar rahe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who is the central character of the story 'A Pinch of Snuff'?
questions.explanation: Kahani ke mukhya aur sabse aakarshak patr Nanukaka hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What animal did Nanukaka bring along with him in a basket?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka apne sath ek tokri mein billi ka bachha (kitten) lekar aaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Nanukaka was standing at the doorway of a .......... class carriage.
questions.explanation: Nanukaka second class bogie ke darwaze par khade hokar hath hila rahe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who frequently took a pinch of snuff from a silver box?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka aksar apni chandi ki dibbi se soonghani (snuff) liya karte the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who was Ratiram in the story?
questions.explanation: Ratiram Lala Sohanlal Ratiram ka beta tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Lala Sohanlal Ratiram was a prominent .......... in Delhi.
questions.explanation: Lala Sohanlal Ratiram Delhi ke ek prabhavshali Party Boss the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What kind of coat did Nanukaka wear on his visits?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne band gale ka Jodhpuri coat pehna hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In a linguistic emergency, Nanukaka always turned to his ..........
questions.explanation: Gusse ya aapat sthiti mein Nanukaka hamesha apni matribhasha (mother tongue) bolne lagte the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who is the Ambassador mentioned in the story 'A Pinch of Snuff'?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Barkat Ali videsh mein Bharat ke rajkoot (Ambassador) the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Nanukaka had an extraordinary talent for telling ..........
questions.explanation: Nanukaka bina jhijhak ke behad vishwas ke sath jhooth (lies) bolne mein maahir the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the term 'probation' mean in the Under-Secretary's job?
questions.explanation: 'Probation' ka matlab prashikshan ya aazmaish ke daur (on training/trial) par hona hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to the narrator, ministers are regarded as .......... steps higher than God.
questions.explanation: Lekhak ke anusar Under-Secretaries ko sikhaya jata hai ki mantri bhagwan se do kadam unche hote hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The narrator and the son of .......... worked in the same ministry.
questions.explanation: Lekhak aur Sohanlal ka beta Ratiram ek hi mantralaya mein kaam karte the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was Sohanlal Ratiram doing when the narrator and Nanukaka arrived?
questions.explanation: Kamre ke andar Sohanlal aaram se hookah gudguda rahe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who refused the proposal of his daughter's marriage with Sohanlal's son?
questions.explanation: Welfare Minister ne apni beti ki shadi Sohanlal ke bete se karne se inkar kar diya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Whom did Nanukaka plan to visit after meeting Lala Sohanlal?
questions.explanation: Sohanlal se milne ke baad Nanukaka Welfare Minister se milne ke liye tayyar huye.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who disguised himself as a liveried chauffeur?
questions.explanation: Lekhak ne shahi vardi pehan kar Nanukaka ke driver (chauffeur) ka roop dharan kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Nanukaka wrote a cheque for .......... rupees to impress the car dealer.
questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne ek hazar rupaye (1000 rupees) ka cheque likha tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: After writing the cheque, whom did Nanukaka instruct the narrator to call?
questions.explanation: Cheque likhne ke baad Nanukaka ne lekhak se dhobi ko bulane ko kaha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: To which car showroom did Nanukaka and the narrator drive?
questions.explanation: Weh badi car lene ke liye Sikka Auto Dealers ke showroom gaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who made the dramatic statement: 'There is nothing like honesty'?
questions.explanation: Dhobi se cheque wapas lene ka natak karte huye Nanukaka ne yeh dialogue bola tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: As a reward, what denomination note did Nanukaka hand over to the washerman?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne dhobi ko inam ke taur par 2 rupaye ka note diya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In what guise did Nanukaka present himself to the Welfare Minister?

options.C: Hereditary Astrologer to the Maharaja of Ninnore

questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne khud ko Ninnore ke Maharaja ka vanshanugat jyotishi bataya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did Nanukaka routinely do before speaking in important situations?
questions.explanation: Kuchh bhi bolne ya chalne se pehle Nanukaka chutki bhar soonghani soonghte the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: For what underlying purpose had Nanukaka travelled to Delhi?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka kisi mantri se milne ke maksad se Delhi aaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Nanukaka managed to travel in a second-class carriage on a ticket of ..........
questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne third-class ke ticket par aaram se second class compartment mein yatra ki.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Whose Delhi residence address did Nanukaka write in the minister's visitor's book?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne visitor's book mein lekhak ke ghar ka pata darj kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who kept a white angocha draped casually around his shoulders?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne apne kandhe par safed angocha dala hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the specific portfolio of the minister Nanukaka targeted?
questions.explanation: Weh mantri Welfare (kalyan) vibhag ke prabhari the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who assured the narrator that Nanukaka would successfully manage everything?
questions.explanation: Lekhak ki maa ne bharosa dilaya tha ki Nanukaka sab sambhal lenge.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: From which collection has the short story 'A Pinch of Snuff' been extracted?

options.A: Contemporary Indian Short Stories in English
options.B: Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats

questions.explanation: Yeh kahani 'Contemporary Indian Short Stories in English' sangrah se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where did Nanukaka and the narrator first go to meet the minister?
questions.explanation: Mantri se milne ke liye weh sabse pehle North Block gaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What kind of turban did the narrator wear while acting as Nanukaka's chauffeur?
questions.explanation: Lekhak ke sir par bada narangi safa (huge orange turban) bandha gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Whose daughter was the Welfare Minister's daughter going to marry?
questions.explanation: Welfare Minister apni beti ka rishta Ninnore ke Rajkumar se tay kar rahe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How did the Welfare Minister react after reading Nanukaka's entry in the visitor's book?

options.B: He personally visited the narrator's house next day

questions.explanation: Ninnore ke shahi jyotishi ka naam dekhkar mantri ji agle hi din khud milne chale aaye.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which Indian state was Manohar Malgaonkar born?
questions.explanation: Manohar Malgaonkar ka janmasthan Karnataka rajya mein tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Over how many publications stand to the credit of Manohar Malgaonkar?
questions.explanation: Manohar Malgaonkar ke naam 25 se adhik pustakein prakashit hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where did the narrator have to sleep after giving his bedroom to Nanukaka?

options.B: On a charpoy in the back verandah

questions.explanation: Nanukaka ko apna bistar dekar lekhak ko peechhe ke baramde mein khat par sona pada tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What official post was Ratiram desperately trying to get abroad?

options.B: Trade Commissioner in the Indian Embassy

questions.explanation: Ratiram Hazrat Barkat Ali ke dootawas mein Trade Commissioner banne ki koshish kar raha tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why was Lala Sohanlal Ratiram deeply offended by the Welfare Minister?

options.A: Because the minister refused his son's marriage proposal
options.B: Because the minister stole his car
options.C: Because the minister took away his party post
options.D: Because the minister refused to meet him

questions.explanation: Mantri ne Sohanlal ke bete ka rishta thukra kar Ninnore ke rajkumar ko chuna tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How did Nanukaka manage the Ticket Collector regarding his ticket disparity?

options.B: By charming him and settling the matter with the kitten
options.C: By running away from the platform

questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne apni baton se TT ko prabhavit karke mamla suljha liya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did the dhobi bring running into the car dealership?

options.B: An old tweed coat with a thousand-rupee cheque in the pocket

questions.explanation: Dhobi ne purane coat ki jeb se ek hazar ka cheque lakar natak ka hissa poora kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the immediate effect of the cheque drama on the manager of Sikka Auto Dealers?

options.B: He was completely impressed and readily offered the luxury car

questions.explanation: Showroom manager Nanukaka ki jhoothi ameeri se behad prabhavit hokar car dene ko tayyar ho gaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What linguistic background did Nanukaka belong to based on his mother tongue?
questions.explanation: Nanukaka Maharashtrian Marathi bhasha bolne wale parivar se jude the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the narrator's constant inner anxiety throughout Nanukaka's deception?

options.B: That his uncle's fabrications would be exposed and cause disaster
options.D: That the car would break down

questions.explanation: Lekhak ko har pal dar rehta tha ki jhooth pakde jaane par sabhi phas jayenge.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following novels is authored by Manohar Malgaonkar?
questions.explanation: 'A Bend in the Ganges' Manohar Malgaonkar ka ek vishva-prasiddh upanyas hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What kind of impression did Nanukaka leave on everyone he encountered?

options.B: An influential, sharp, and aristocratic personality

questions.explanation: Nanukaka ne apni chal-dhal aur baatchit se sabhi ko apna prabhavi roop dikhaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the phrase 'a linguistic emergency' signify in the story?

options.B: Involuntary outburst in one's native dialect during overwhelming emotion

questions.explanation: Achanak krodh ya ghabrahat mein apni matribhasha ki or lautne ko linguistic emergency kaha gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What role did flattery play in Nanukaka's plans?

options.B: It served as a key weapon to disarm opponents and gain access to ministers

questions.explanation: Chaploosi aur jhootha dikhava Nanukaka ka sabse bada hathiyar tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the main purpose of the huge orange turban tied on the narrator?

options.B: To give him the authentic regal appearance of an aristocratic chauffeur

questions.explanation: Narangi safa lekhak ko ek shahi driver ka dikhavati roop dene ke liye bandha gaya tha.
